definitions.detection_rules: Look for Vue components in the image, focusing on PrimeVue styling patterns and component structures
Look for CSS utility classes with p- prefix in the image, focusing on layout, spacing, and flexbox utilities
Look for icon elements with pi- class prefix in the image, focusing on PrimeIcons styling and positioning

LeadPriorityIndicator.description: Visual indicator showing lead priority and potential value
LeadPriorityIndicator.purpose: Help sales teams prioritize their efforts and focus on high-value opportunities
LeadPriorityIndicator.business_logic: Priority calculated based on company size, budget, timeline, and engagement level
LeadPriorityIndicator.interactions: Click to view detailed scoring breakdown, hover for quick insights
LeadPriorityIndicator.visual_patterns: Color-coded badges with priority text, usually near lead information
LeadPriorityIndicator.detection_rules: Look for colored priority badges with text like 'Hot', 'Warm', 'Cold', 'VIP' in the image

PipelineStageTracker.description: Visual representation of sales pipeline with stage progression
PipelineStageTracker.purpose: Track opportunity progress through sales stages and identify bottlenecks
PipelineStageTracker.business_logic: Stages represent actual sales process with time tracking and conversion rates
PipelineStageTracker.interactions: Drag and drop opportunities between stages, click for stage details
PipelineStageTracker.visual_patterns: Horizontal or vertical stage bars with opportunity cards
PipelineStageTracker.detection_rules: Look for stage-based layouts with drag-and-drop indicators and opportunity cards in the image

Customer360Card.description: Comprehensive customer information display with action shortcuts
Customer360Card.purpose: Provide complete customer context for informed decision making and relationship building
Customer360Card.business_logic: Aggregates data from multiple systems (CRM, billing, support, marketing)
Customer360Card.interactions: Expandable sections, quick action buttons, real-time updates
Customer360Card.visual_patterns: Card layout with customer photo, information sections, and action buttons
Customer360Card.detection_rules: Look for customer profile cards with avatar, information sections, and multiple action buttons in the image

SmartActionButton.description: Context-aware action button that adapts based on customer state and user permissions
SmartActionButton.purpose: Streamline common sales actions and ensure consistent process execution
SmartActionButton.business_logic: Actions dynamically change based on customer status, sales stage, and user role
SmartActionButton.interactions: Click to execute action, shows confirmation and next steps
SmartActionButton.visual_patterns: Contextual buttons that change appearance based on customer state
SmartActionButton.detection_rules: Look for action buttons that change color, text, or state based on context in the image

RevenueForecastWidget.description: Real-time revenue forecasting with trend analysis and predictive insights
RevenueForecastWidget.purpose: Provide sales managers with accurate revenue projections and pipeline health metrics
RevenueForecastWidget.business_logic: Uses historical data, current pipeline, and AI-powered prediction models
RevenueForecastWidget.interactions: Interactive charts, drill-down capabilities, export functionality
RevenueForecastWidget.visual_patterns: Charts and graphs with revenue data, trend lines, and forecasting elements
RevenueForecastWidget.detection_rules: Look for revenue charts, forecasting graphs, and financial metrics displays in the image
